week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Partly sunny. High near 57, with temperatures falling to around 52 in the afternoon. South wind 1 to 5 mph.

week.detailed: Rain. Cloudy, with a high near 51. South wind 2 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 44.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 44.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Rain and snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 40. New snow accumulation of less than half an inch possible.

week.name: Saturday
week.short: Slight Chance Light Snow then Partly Sunny
week.detailed: A slight chance of snow before 11am. Partly sunny, with a high near 41.
week.night_short: Mostly Cloudy then Slight Chance Light Snow

discussion.key_messages: - A cold system rich with Pacific moisture will bring widespread rain and mountain snow to the region late Monday through Tuesday. - An even colder system impacts the region Thursday into Friday, with more substantial snowfall expected for all Utah mountains given lower snow levels. Light accumulations could also make it down to 5000 feet late Friday. - Coldest temperatures of the season are expected behind the late week system, with freeze conditions possible for lower Washington County and the Zion National Park area on Saturday.
